<?xml version="1.0"?>


<PropertyList>

	<path>A-10-throttle.ac</path>

	<!-- APU switch -->
	<animation>
		<object-name>apu-start-switch</object-name>
		<type>rotate</type>
		<property>controls/APU/off-start-switch</property>
		<interpolation>
			<entry><ind>0</ind><dep>-30</dep></entry>
			<entry><ind>1</ind><dep>30</dep></entry>
		</interpolation>
		<center>
			<x-m>0.0245</x-m>
			<z-m>0.0031</z-m>
		</center>
		<axis> <y>-1</y></axis>
	</animation>
	<!-- L engine operation switch -->
	<animation>
		<object-name>l-eng-oper-switch</object-name>
		<type>rotate</type>
		<property>sim/model/A-10/controls/engines/engine[0]/starter-switch-position</property>
		<interpolation>
			<entry><ind>0</ind><dep>-30</dep></entry>
			<entry><ind>1</ind><dep>0</dep></entry>
			<entry><ind>2</ind><dep>30</dep></entry>
		</interpolation>
		<center>
			<x-m>-0.0190</x-m>
			<z-m>0.0031</z-m>
		</center>
		<axis><y>-1</y> </axis>
	</animation>
	<!-- R engine operation switch -->
	<animation>
		<object-name>r-eng-oper-switch</object-name>
		<type>rotate</type>
		<property>sim/model/A-10/controls/engines/engine[1]/starter-switch-position</property>
		<interpolation>
			<entry><ind>0</ind><dep>-30</dep></entry>
			<entry><ind>1</ind><dep>0</dep></entry>
			<entry><ind>2</ind><dep>30</dep></entry>
		</interpolation>
		<center>
			<x-m>-0.0190</x-m>
			<z-m>-0.0031</z-m>
		</center>
		<axis><y>-1</y></axis>
	</animation>


	<!-- Throttles -->
	<animation> 
		<object-name>r-throttle</object-name>
		<type>rotate</type>
		<property>sim/model/A-10/controls/engines/engine[1]/throttle</property>
		<factor>41</factor>
		<center>
			<x-m>0.0000</x-m>
			<z-m>-0.0852</z-m>
		</center>
		<axis><y>-1</y></axis>
	</animation>

	<animation> 
		<object-name>l-throttle</object-name>
		<type>rotate</type>
		<property>sim/model/A-10/controls/engines/engine[0]/throttle</property>
		<factor>41</factor>
		<center>
			<x-m>0.0000</x-m>
			<z-m>-0.0852</z-m>
		</center>
		<axis><y>-1</y></axis>
	</animation>



	<!-- Flaps lever -->
	<animation>
		<object-name>flaps-lever</object-name>
		<type>rotate</type>
		<property>sim/flaps/current-setting</property>
		<interpolation>
			<entry><ind>0</ind><dep>30</dep></entry>
			<entry><ind>1</ind><dep>0</dep></entry>
			<entry><ind>2</ind><dep>-30</dep></entry>
		</interpolation>
		<center>
			<x-m>0.067</x-m>
			<z-m>-0.008</z-m>
		</center>
		<axis><y>-1</y></axis>
	</animation>

<!-- lighting -->

	<animation>
		<object-name>panel</object-name>
		<type>material</type>
		<condition><not><property>/sim/rendering/rembrandt/enabled</property></not></condition>
		<emission>
			<factor-prop>controls/lighting/panel-norm</factor-prop>
			<red>0.385</red>
			<green>0.168</green>
			<blue>0.07</blue>
		</emission>
	</animation>

	<animation>
		<object-name>throttles</object-name>
		<type>material</type>
		<condition><not><property>/sim/rendering/rembrandt/enabled</property></not></condition>
		<emission>
			<factor-prop>controls/lighting/panel-norm</factor-prop>
			<red>0.275</red>
			<green>0.12</green>
			<blue>0.05</blue>
		</emission>
	</animation>


	<animation>
		<type>range</type>
		<min-m>0</min-m>
		<max-m>5</max-m>
	</animation>

</PropertyList>

<!-- F-15D Canopy (single seat applicable to F-15A variant as well)
   |  Richard Harrison: 2015-04-29 : rjh@zaretto.com 
-->

<PropertyList>
    <path>f-15d-canopy.ac</path>

    <!--FG 3.5 ALS Glass effects -->
    <effect>
        <name>f15glass</name>
        <inherits-from>Aircraft/F-15/Models/Effects/f15glass</inherits-from>
        <object-name>CanopyGlassInside</object-name>
    </effect>
    <effect>
        <name>f15windshield</name>
        <inherits-from>Aircraft/F-15/Models/Effects/f15windshield</inherits-from>
        <object-name>WindscreenGlassInside</object-name>
    </effect>
    <!-- Canopy -->
    <animation>
        <type>select</type>
        <condition>
            <equals>
                <property>sim/model/f15/variant</property>
                <value>D</value>
            </equals>
        </condition>
        <object-name>f15d-canopy</object-name>
    </animation>
    <animation>
        <type>select</type>
        <condition>
            <not>
                <property>/sim/rendering/rembrandt/enabled</property>
            </not>
        </condition>
        <object-name>CanopyGlassInside</object-name>
        <object-name>WindscreenGlassInside</object-name>
    </animation>

    <animation>
        <type>rotate</type>
        <object-name>Canopy</object-name>
        <object-name>CanopyGlass</object-name>
        <object-name>CanopyGlassInside</object-name>
        <object-name>CanopyFasteners</object-name>
        <object-name>CanopyMirrors</object-name >
        <object-name>CanopyWire</object-name >
        <object-name>StandbyCompass</object-name>
        <object-name>CanopyRefuelReadyLightLamp</object-name>
        <object-name>CanopyLockShootLightLamp</object-name>
        <object-name>CanopyBackCover</object-name>
        <object-name>CanopyLockShootLight</object-name>
        <object-name>CanopyRefuelReadyLight</object-name>
        <property>canopy/position-norm</property>
        <interpolation>
            <entry>
                <ind>0.25</ind>
                <dep>0.0</dep>
            </entry>
            <entry>
                <ind>1.0</ind>
                <dep>20.0</dep>
            </entry>
        </interpolation>
        <center>
            <x-m>-2.36</x-m>
            <y-m>0.0</y-m>
            <z-m>1.4</z-m>
        </center>
        <axis>
            <x>0.0</x>
            <y>1.0</y>
            <z>0.0</z>
        </axis>
    </animation>
    <!-- Timing from https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MSWz55b_jtE 2:25-->
    <animation>
        <type>translate</type>
        <object-name>Canopy</object-name>
        <object-name>CanopyGlass</object-name>
        <object-name>CanopyGlassInside</object-name>
        <object-name>CanopyFasteners</object-name>
        <object-name>CanopyMirrors</object-name >
        <object-name>CanopyWire</object-name >
        <object-name>StandbyCompass</object-name>
        <object-name>CanopyRefuelReadyLightLamp</object-name>
        <object-name>CanopyLockShootLightLamp</object-name>
        <object-name>CanopyBackCover</object-name>
        <object-name>CanopyLockShootLight</object-name>
        <object-name>CanopyRefuelReadyLight</object-name>
        <property>canopy/position-norm</property>
        <interpolation>
            <entry>
                <ind>0.0</ind>
                <dep>0.0</dep>
            </entry>
            <entry>
                <ind>0.25</ind>
                <dep>0.01</dep>
            </entry>
        </interpolation>
        <center>
            <x-m>-2.36</x-m>
            <y-m>0.0</y-m>
            <z-m>1.4</z-m>
        </center>
        <axis>
            <x>1</x>
        </axis>
    </animation>
    <effect>
        <name>f15canopy-glass</name>
        <inherits-from>Effects/exterior-glass</inherits-from>
        <object-name>WindscreenGlass</object-name>
        <object-name>CanopyGlass</object-name>
    </effect>
    <!--<animation>
        <type>shader</type>
        <shader>chrome</shader>
        <texture>Aircraft/F-15/Models/glass_shader.png</texture>
        <object-name>WindscreenGlass</object-name>
        <object-name>CanopyGlass</object-name>
    </animation>-->

    <animation>
        <type>rotate</type>
        <object-name>StandbyCompassSphere</object-name>
        <property>instrumentation/magnetic-compass/indicated-heading-deg</property>
        <center>
            <x-m>-5.5611</x-m>
            <y-m>0.1851</y-m>
            <z-m>1.5392</z-m>
        </center>
        <axis>
            <z>1</z>
        </axis>
    </animation>

<?xml version="1.0"?>

<!-- Mig-29 9-12                         -->
<!-- Gary R. Neely 'Buckaroo', Jan 2008  -->
<!--

Lighting control properties are passed over MP, therefore the animations
take their cues from the MP properties rather than the source control
properties. Here are the control to MP prop mappings as defined under
Mig-29.nas:

var Mig29_MPNav		= props.globals.getNode("/sim/multiplay/generic/float[4]");

-->

<PropertyList>

<path>mesh_lights.ac</path>


<!-- Special Shaders -->

<animation>
  <type>noshadow</type>
<!--
  <object-name>BeaconL</object-name>
  <object-name>BeaconU</object-name>
  <object-name>BeaconLOn</object-name>
  <object-name>BeaconUOn</object-name>
-->
  <object-name>TailLamp</object-name>
  <object-name>TailLampOn</object-name>
  <object-name>WingtipLampL</object-name>
  <object-name>WingtipLampR</object-name>
  <object-name>WingtipLampLOn</object-name>
  <object-name>WingtipLampROn</object-name>
<!--
  <object-name>LightTaxiGlow</object-name>
-->
  <object-name>LightTailGlow</object-name>
  <object-name>LightNavGlowL</object-name>
  <object-name>LightNavGlowR</object-name>
</animation>


<!-- Animations -->

<!--
<animation>
  <type>select</type>
  <object-name>BeaconLOn</object-name>
  <object-name>BeaconUOn</object-name>
  <condition>
    <and>
      <property>/controls/lighting/beacon</property>
      <property>sim/model/Mig-29/lighting/beacon/state[0]</property>
    </and>
  </condition>
</animation>
-->

<animation>
  <type>select</type>
  <object-name>TailLampOn</object-name>
  <condition>
    <property>sim/multiplay/generic/float[4]</property>
  </condition>
</animation>

<animation>
  <type>select</type>
  <object-name>TailLamp</object-name>
  <condition>
    <not><property>sim/multiplay/generic/float[4]</property></not>
  </condition>
</animation>

<animation>
  <type>select</type>
  <object-name>WingtipLampLOn</object-name>
  <object-name>WingtipLampROn</object-name>
  <condition>
    <property>/controls/lighting/nav</property>
  </condition>
</animation>

<animation>
  <type>select</type>
  <object-name>WingtipLampL</object-name>
  <object-name>WingtipLampR</object-name>
  <condition>
    <not><property>sim/multiplay/generic/float[4]</property></not>
  </condition>
</animation>


<!-- Left (red) nav light -->

<animation>
  <type>select</type>
  <object-name>LightNavGlowL</object-name>
  <condition>
    <property>sim/multiplay/generic/float[4]</property>
  </condition>
</animation>

<animation>
  <type>flash</type>
  <object-name>LightNavGlowL</object-name>
  <center>
   <x-m>11.761</x-m>
   <y-m>-5.721</y-m>
   <z-m>0.113</z-m>
  </center>
  <axis>
   <x>-1</x>
   <y>-1</y>
   <z>0</z>
  </axis>
  <power>4</power>
  <factor>1</factor>
  <offset>0.4</offset>
  <two-sides type="bool">false</two-sides>
  <min>0.01</min>
  <max>1</max>
</animation>


<!-- Right (green) nav light -->

<animation>
  <type>select</type>
  <object-name>LightNavGlowR</object-name>
  <condition>
    <property>sim/multiplay/generic/float[4]</property>
  </condition>
</animation>
